title: Quietly Rich Indian Idli
description: A rich and quiet take on the traditional Indian idli. A comforting breakfast dish that pairs perfectly with a warm beverage.
instructions: Soak the idli rice and urad dal in water for 4-5 hours.
Drain and rinse the rice and dal. Grind them into a smooth batter in a blender or food processor.
Add the fenugreek seeds, yogurt, and 1 cup of water to the grinder. Blend until well combined.
Transfer the batter to a large bowl. Add 2 cups of water and mix well.
The batter should be smooth and free of lumps. Cover and let it ferment for 4-5 hours.
Preheat a non-stick idli steamer or a metal steamer basket. Grease the idli molds with oil.
Pour the batter into the molds, filling them about 3/4 of the way.
Steam the idlis for 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat and let them cool.
Serve the idlis with a dollop of yogurt and a sprinkle of chutney or sambar.
